compute_filetypes_response: compute the filetypes response for a HuggingFace dataset including files inside zip archives
get_filetypes: get a list of filetypes with counts from a list of HuggingFace repo sibling files
get_counter_from_archive: get a counter of file extensions inside a zip archive on a HuggingFace dataset
get_filetypes_from_archives: get filetypes with counts from multiple zip archives in a HuggingFace dataset
extension_to_filetype: convert a file extension tuple and count into a Filetype object
